title: Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.19779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute

translated_title: 先读后拟合：利用文本衍生的约束从含噪生物数据中发现微分方程
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型正被越来越多地应用于科学方程发现。然而，现有方法大多高度依赖数据驱动，并假设观测数据足够干净且具有代表性。这一假设在生物系统中是有问题的，因为个体层面的测量数据往往是稀疏、含噪、异质且获取成本高昂的。尽管这些系统的底层机制在科学文献中已有广泛描述，但这些文本信息并未被明确用于基于LLM的系统建模。我们提出了P2C，一个智能体框架，它将生物系统的文本描述转化为类型化的形式约束集合，并利用这些约束在数值拟合之前限制候选常微分方程（ODE）的结构。P2C包含五个阶段：Text2Constraint约束提取、ODE发现、符号验证、参数拟合和模型评分。我们在四个已发表的系统上对P2C进行了评估（急性……）。
tldr: 该论文提出P2C智能体框架，将生物系统的文本描述转化为形式化约束，在数值拟合前先约束候选常微分方程的结构，从而在稀疏、含噪的生物数据条件下更可靠地进行方程发现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into formal constraints to restrict candidate ODE structures before numerical fitting, enabling more reliable equation discovery from sparse and noisy biological data.
